mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_drama WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND external_drama_id = #{externalDramaId}
SELECT * FROM provider_drama ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_drama (connection_id,external_drama_id,title,original_title,description,cover_url,language,drama_type,remote_show_status,remote_updated_at,last_seen_at) VALUES (#{connectionId},#{externalDramaId},#{title},#{originalTitle},#{description},#{coverUrl},#{language},#{dramaType},#{remoteShowStatus},#{remoteUpdatedAt},#{lastSeenAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),original_title=VALUES(original_title),description=VALUES(description),cover_url=VALUES(cover_url),language=VALUES(language),drama_type=VALUES(drama_type),remote_show_status=VALUES(remote_show_status),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),last_seen_at=VALUES(last_seen_at),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_drama_content WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_drama_content (drama_id,external_content_id,sequence_no,title,is_free,duration_seconds,remote_updated_at) VALUES (#{dramaId},#{externalContentId},#{sequenceNo},#{title},#{free},#{durationSeconds},#{remoteUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE external_content_id=VALUES(external_content_id),title=VALUES(title),is_free=VALUES(is_free),duration_seconds=VALUES(duration_seconds),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
